Name: Bee Paths
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod shows you where a bee house is currently getting its honey from by drawing bees flying back and forth between the house and the flower.

You can customize the number, colour, size, and speed of the bees in the config.

You can also give the bees a chance to sting farmers that walk in their paths.

By default this mod changes the vanilla flower finding logic from counting tiles to calculating actual distance between tiles, and you can change the max flower-to-bee-house distance in the config.

You can also enable bee sounds in the config by increasing the max sound distance.

This mod also works with the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14061/]Wild Flowers[/url].


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.
